changelog: Two libraries in one app: Kuronime for anime and Oppa for dramas and movies, switchable anytime — each catalog stays separate.
Home rails for every section: Latest, Movies, drama by country, Completed, Top Rated, and the weekly release Schedule with estimated times.
Custom player: resume where you left off, a quality picker with real codec tags, double-tap seek, and auto-next episode.
Offline downloads with background downloading and resume.
